items.quote: And I came this day unto the well
items.claim: The speaker came to the well on 'this day'

items.quote: if now thou do prosper my way which I go
items.claim: The speaker requests God to prosper their journey

items.quote: Behold, I stand by the well of water
items.claim: The speaker stands by the well of water

items.quote: when the virgin cometh forth to draw water
items.claim: A virgin will come forth to draw water

items.quote: and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink
items.claim: The speaker will ask the virgin for water from her pitcher

items.quote: Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels
items.claim: The virgin will respond by offering water to drink and drawing water for the speaker's camels

items.quote: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son
items.claim: This response will be the sign that the LORD has appointed this woman for the master's son
